headline: São Paulo Installs Free Flow Electronic Tolls on Castello Branco Highway
summary: The São Paulo government began installing Siga Fácil free-flow electronic tolls on the Castello Branco highway, enabling seamless toll payments without vehicle stops or speed reductions.
why: Adoption of electronic free-flow toll systems modernizes highway concession operations, improving traffic efficiency and cash collection reliability for toll road operators.

impacts.name: Transportation Infrastructure
impacts.why: Automated toll collection reduces operating friction for concessionaires.
